coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.distance_note: About 470m from the tracked Pier 70 D4D parcel's own boundary (versus about 665m from Potrero Power Station's tracked boundary) -- Dogpatch, between 19th and 20th St near Indiana St/I-280.

how_to_comment.channel: Clerk of the Board of Supervisors

record.summary: A proposed 3-story-plus-basement lab/office building at 700 Indiana St in Dogpatch, replacing an existing one-story building, for tenant MBC BioLabs. SF Planning Commission approved the project in June 2024; a neighborhood appeal of its CEQA exemption was rejected by the Board of Supervisors in September 2024, clearing it to proceed. No building permit had been issued as of September 2026.

notes.digitized_from: The real DataSF Assessor parcel for blklot 4062007 (700 Indiana St, Dogpatch), taken from DataSF's Assessor parcel data on 2026-09-28. The polygon itself is the real, unmodified Assessor shape.
notes.regulatory_context: SF Planning Case No. 2023-001074ENX. Planning Commission approved the project 2024-06-13 (Motion No. 21576): a 3-story-plus-basement, ~70,650-72,350 gross sq ft lab/office building (sources give slightly different figures) replacing an existing ~15,068 sq ft one-story building, for MBC BioLabs. A neighborhood appeal of the CEQA general plan evaluation exemption was rejected by the Board of Supervisors 9-1 on 2024-09-24 (Supervisor Walton dissenting), clearing the project to proceed. No DataSF building permit found as of 2026-09-28, so construction has apparently not yet started.

facts.value: Dewey Land Company (purchased the site in 2022 for $15,000,000)
MBC BioLabs (expanding from its flagship campus at 953 Indiana St)

Reported as approximately 70,650 sq ft (Planning Commission motion language) or 72,349-72,350 sq ft (CEQA Notice of Exemption and a Feb 2025 news report) -- sources disagree by about 1,700 sq ft; both figures kept rather than picking one. Replaces an existing approximately 15,068 sq ft one-story building on a 0.71-acre (31,090 sq ft) lot.
Reported as either 48 ft (north) / 33 ft (south) per the CEQA filing, or a 54 ft height cap per a Feb 2025 news report -- discrepancy not resolved here.

open_questions: Two different named appeal bodies appear in sources on this project: the Board of Supervisors (which heard and rejected the CEQA exemption appeal, resolved 2024-09-24, the event recorded above) and a separate Board of Appeals item (Appeal No. 24-040, continued to a Nov 13, 2024 hearing) whose subject and outcome could not be confirmed -- not established here whether it is the same matter under a different docket or a genuinely separate appeal.
No construction start date or building permit has been found as of 2026-09-28; status is recorded as planned rather than under_construction pending better evidence.
The gross square footage and height figures differ between the CEQA filing and a Feb 2025 news report; both are kept in facts rather than resolved to one number.
The $40,000,000 estimated construction cost is from secondary reporting only, not independently confirmed against a primary Planning or permit document.
